title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-08-01
source: Soundboard > 7.5ips Master Reel > Cassette > 20 bit A/D > CDR

ai_review.summary: Crispy soundboard capture of a smoking 1973 Dark Star → El Paso → Eyes of the World → Morning Dew sequence – a birthday‑celebration highlight for Jerry.
ai_review.review: The partial tape delivers an electrifying stretch of the 1973 run, with Dark Star, El Paso, Eyes of the World and a soaring Morning Dew hailed as smoking, emotional peaks. Reviewers praise the clear, crisp soundboard source and note no technical flaws, making it one of the standout ’73 fragments.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive comments (mostly 5‑star) highlight exceptional performance and clear recording; only one outlier negative review does not affect the consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as 'crispy' and clear; no dropout or muffling reported. The .sbd tag confirms a soundboard source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A seamless, high‑energy arc that builds from a smoldering Dark Star through a fiery El Paso into an intense Eyes of the World, climaxing with an emotionally charged Morning Dew – praised as an ideal birthday celebration set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for his soaring guitar tone, wicked slide work, and being at the peak of his powers during this birthday performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted as 'plain sick' on the Mind Left Body jam within Dark Star, delivering a strong bass contribution.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned affectionately ('I love Bob') but without specific performance commentary.
